hooks.text: Russia claimed their missile test threatened nobody in space.
A missile strike trapped astronauts inside emergency escape pods.
Over 1,500 shrapnel shards trapped astronauts in escape pods.

title: The Missile Strike That Trapped Cosmonauts
description: When an anti-satellite missile obliterated Kosmos 1408, it generated over 1,500 trackable fragments. The debris cloud forced the ISS crew into emergency escape pods.

beats.text: Russia claimed their missile test threatened nobody in space.
beats.visual: Plesetsk Cosmodrome launch facility on Earth, 2021

beats.text: Destroying the Kosmos satellite made over 1,500 trackable fragments.
beats.visual: Computer visualization of orbital space debris field around Earth, 2021

beats.text: It generated hundreds of thousands of smaller, untrackable debris pieces.
queries: Space junk illustration low Earth orbit

beats.text: That cloud crossed the Space Station's path roughly every 90 minutes.
beats.visual: International Space Station orbiting high above Earth, 2021

beats.text: Seven crew members had to seal hatches and take emergency shelter.
beats.visual: Expedition 66 astronauts inside an International Space Station module, 2021

beats.text: They hid inside docked SpaceX Crew Dragon and Russian Soyuz spacecraft.
beats.visual: SpaceX Crew Dragon spacecraft docked to International Space Station, 2021

beats.text: That test directly endangered two of Russia's own cosmonauts.
beats.visual: Cosmonauts Anton Shkaplerov and Pyotr Dubrov aboard station, 2021

beats.text: NASA called it unthinkable that Russia would risk its own crew.
beats.visual: NASA Administrator Bill Nelson speaking at headquarters briefing, 2021
queries: Bill Nelson NASA headquarters press briefing
NASA Administrator Bill Nelson official portrait

beats.text: Yet officials still claimed the blast threatened nobody in space.
beats.visual: High-orbit view of space debris fragments crossing orbital paths, 2021
queries: Space debris low Earth orbit computer model

better_than_last: Applies the hazard pacing rule by holding the safety resolution until after the climax and delivers the core contradiction immediately without trivia detours.
